blinding_guess.why: All xacro usage is the namespaced form (xacro:include/property/macro/insert_block under xmlns:xacro), the launch files call the $(find xacro)/xacro script rather than xacro.py, and pi is taken from xacro's built-in symbols; nothing uses the deprecated unprefixed <property>/<insert_block>. The only irregularity is that package.xml declares no run_depend on xacro although the launch files invoke it.

notes: Scope: snapshot/ur_description only (package.xml 1.1.6, CMakeLists.txt, launch/test.launch, launch/ur{3,5,10}_upload.launch, 12 urdf/*.xacro files, meshes, model.pdf). All ten packet elements are consumed xacro API elements, so declares and not_declared are empty by rule. Ports are listed only for the seven elements the code actually uses; frame, units, QoS, rates and definition_id are null because these are build-time XML-processing API elements, not ROS data ports (and this is ROS 1). Consumed packet elements that the package does NOT reference at this revision (hence absent from ports and references): api:<insert_block> (no occurrence anywhere in ur_description); api:<property> (no active unprefixed tag; the only occurrences are commented-out lines ur5.urdf.xacro:53-60 written as '<!--property name=... -->'); api:xacro.py (no occurrence in ur_description; the launch files use $(find xacro)/xacro). Other xacro constructs used but not in the packet: xacro:if / xacro:unless (e.g. ur5.urdf.xacro:105-110) and macro default parameters with ':=' (ur10.urdf.xacro:64-70, defaults ${-pi}/${pi}). package.xml run_depend lists only urdf (line 20); xacro is not declared as a dependency. exclusive left empty: ur.transmission.xacro:9,19,29,39,49,59 declare <hardwareInterface>PositionJointInterface</hardwareInterface> for each joint, which declares the ros_control interface type rather than claiming a resource exclusively. Other packages in the same repository snapshot (ur3/ur5/ur10_moveit_config planning_context.launch:11-12) also call $(find xacro)/xacro on ur_description files; they were not described here.
